_source: Mined 23 Oct 2026 from 16 real xHire interviews (calls >=10 min where the candidate spoke 700+ words), plus the two the owner remembers (prioritize, sell to an executive who won't budge). v2 (24 Oct, owner): every distinct question is its own line on the left: a short 'title' in bold with the full question under it, grouped in 'section's; 'ways' are up to 3 rewordings of THAT SAME question (never a different question). 'was' = the v1 group name it replaces (used once to update notes seeded with v1).

groups.title: About me
groups.question: Tell me about yourself.
ways: Walk me through your background.
Give us a quick introduction of yourself.
Can you give me a brief overview of who you are and what you've done?

groups.title: Why I'm leaving
groups.question: Why are you looking to leave your current role?
groups.was: Why are you looking / why this role
ways: What has you looking for a new position right now?
What's making you look for a change?
You're doing well where you are. Why move now?

groups.title: What I want next
groups.question: What are you looking for in your next role?
ways: What would your ideal next job look like?
What do you want to see in your next role?
What matters most to you in your next position?

groups.title: Why this role
groups.question: Why are you interested in this role?
ways: What got you interested in this position?
What drew you to this job?
Why did you apply for this role?

groups.title: What I know about you
groups.question: What do you know about our company?
groups.was: What do you know about us
ways: What have you learned about us so far?
How much do you know about what we do?
Did you get a chance to look into our company?

groups.title: Prioritizing
groups.question: How do you prioritize when everything is urgent?
ways: How do you handle conflicting priorities?
You have two or three projects coming at you at once. How do you handle that?
How do you decide what to work on first?

groups.title: Deadlines and pressure
groups.question: How do you handle tight deadlines and pressure?
ways: How do you work when the timeline is really short?
How do you stay on track when you're under pressure?
Tell me about a time you had to deliver under a tight deadline.

groups.title: Exec who won't budge
groups.question: How do you convince an executive who won't budge?
groups.was: Selling to an executive who won't budge
ways: How do you get buy-in from a leader who isn't sold on your idea?
An executive is set on their way and you think it's wrong. What do you do?
How do you get a senior leader to care about your recommendation?

groups.title: Leaders disagree with my data
groups.question: What do you do when leadership disagrees with what your data shows?
ways: What happens if they want you to go in the wrong direction?
The numbers tell a different story than leadership expects. How do you handle it?
Your analysis goes against what a senior leader believes. What do you do?

groups.title: Asked for one thing, needs another
groups.question: How do you handle a stakeholder who asks for one thing but needs another?
ways: A leader asked for one report but actually needed something different. What did you do?
How do you find out what a stakeholder really needs?
How do you handle a request that doesn't match the real problem?

groups.title: New requirements
groups.question: What's your process when a new requirement comes in?
ways: Walk me through how you gather requirements.
When someone brings you a new request, what do you do first?
How do you scope a new request?

groups.title: Changing requirements
groups.question: How do you handle a stakeholder who keeps changing the requirements?
ways: What do you do when the scope keeps moving?
How do you manage requests that change halfway through?
How do you push back when the ask keeps changing?

groups.title: Checking a report
groups.question: How do you make sure a report is right before it goes to leadership?
ways: How do you validate a dashboard before you share it?
How do you know your numbers are accurate?
What checks do you run before a report goes out?

groups.title: Numbers called wrong
groups.question: The business says your numbers are wrong. How do you look into it?
ways: Someone says the dashboard doesn't match their numbers. What do you do?
How do you troubleshoot a report people say is off?
A leader tells you the data looks wrong. Walk me through your steps.

groups.title: Cleaning messy data
groups.question: How did you turn messy data into clean data you could trust?
ways: How do you deal with questionable data?
Tell me about a time you had to clean up bad data.
How do you handle data quality issues?

groups.title: Dashboard end to end
groups.question: Walk me through a dashboard you built end to end.
ways: Tell me about a dashboard you built and the problem it solved.
What's a report you built from start to finish?
Walk me through one of your dashboards, from the ask to the finished product.

groups.title: How execs used it
groups.question: How were the executives using your dashboards?
ways: What did the team actually do with that data?
What decisions came out of your reports?
What action did people take because of your dashboard?

groups.title: Power BI data models
groups.question: How do you design your Power BI data models?
ways: How many models, fact tables and dimensions did you build to support those reports?
How is your data model set up?
Walk me through how you structure a Power BI model.

groups.title: Develop and deploy
groups.question: How do you develop and deploy a Power BI report?
ways: What does your development and deployment process look like?
How do you take a report from development to the users?
Walk me through how a report goes live.

groups.title: Who sees what
groups.question: How do you control who sees what in Power BI?
ways: How do users get to the reports, and how do you manage access?
Have you set up row-level security?
How do you make sure people only see their own data?

groups.title: Slow Power BI report
groups.question: How do you speed up a slow Power BI report?
ways: A report is taking too long to load. What do you do?
How do you optimize Power BI performance?
What do you look at first when a dashboard is slow?

groups.title: Hardest DAX
groups.question: What's the hardest DAX calculation you've written?
ways: Give me an example of a difficult DAX measure and why it was hard.
What's the most complex DAX you've built?
Tell me about a DAX problem that took you a while to solve.

groups.title: Row right, total wrong
groups.question: A measure is right by row but wrong in the total. How would you fix it?
ways: How would you troubleshoot that measure?
Your totals don't add up in Power BI. What's going on?
Why would a total show a different number than the rows add up to?

groups.title: Slow SQL query
groups.question: Have you tuned a SQL query that was running slow? How?
ways: How do you optimize a slow query?
A query is taking too long. What do you look at?
Tell me about a time you made a query faster.

groups.title: Inner vs left join
groups.question: What's the difference between an inner join and a left join?
ways: When would you use a left join instead of an inner join?
Explain inner and left joins.
How do inner and left joins treat rows that don't match?

groups.title: Window functions
groups.question: When would you use a window function?
ways: What is a window function?
Give me an example of a window function you've used.
How are window functions different from GROUP BY?

groups.title: Pipeline end to end
groups.question: Walk me through a pipeline from raw data to the metrics people use.
ways: How does data get from the source to your dashboards?
Describe your data pipeline end to end.
What layers does your data go through, and what happens in each?

groups.title: Automating manual work
groups.question: Someone does a process by hand every week. How would you automate it?
ways: How would you automate a manual process?
The team is slogging through a manual task. How would you help?
Tell me about something you automated.

groups.title: AI in my work
groups.question: How is AI changing your work?
ways: How are you using AI in your job today?
What AI tools do you use to support your work?
Have you built anything with AI?

groups.title: What people get wrong with AI
groups.question: What are most people getting wrong when they use AI at work?
ways: What mistakes do you see people make with AI?
Where do people go wrong using AI to get work done?
What's the right way to use AI at work?

groups.title: My tools
groups.question: What tools, platforms and databases have you used?
ways: What's your tech stack?
Which tools are you most comfortable with?
What software and databases have you worked in?

groups.title: Great teamwork
groups.question: Tell me about a time you worked really well with others.
ways: Describe a time you collaborated well with a team.
Give me an example of great teamwork you were part of.
What did you do to make a team project work?

groups.title: A difficult person
groups.question: Tell me about a time you worked with a difficult person.
ways: How do you handle a hard coworker?
Tell me about a conflict with a colleague and how you handled it.
Have you had a dispute with someone at work? What happened?

groups.title: My work was challenged
groups.question: Tell me about a time your work was challenged.
ways: Your work was called incomplete. How did you respond?
Tell me about a time someone pushed back on your work.
How do you react when your work gets criticized?

groups.title: Leadership style
groups.question: What's your leadership style?
ways: How would your team describe you as a leader?
How do you lead a team?
What kind of leader are you?

groups.title: Back to hands-on work
groups.question: You've led a team. Are you OK being an individual contributor?
ways: Are you comfortable going back to hands-on work?
Would you be happy without direct reports?
This role has no team under it. Is that OK for you?

groups.title: Why hire me
groups.question: Why should we hire you?
ways: What sets you apart from other candidates?
What makes you the right person for this role?
Why you over everyone else we're talking to?

groups.title: Strengths
groups.question: What are your strengths?
ways: What are you best at?
What would your manager say you do really well?
What's your biggest strength?

groups.title: Weakness
groups.question: What's your biggest weakness?
ways: What's a skill you're still developing?
What area are you working to improve?
What would your manager say you need to work on?

groups.title: Salary
groups.question: What are your salary expectations?
ways: What are you looking for in pay?
Is that still the range you're looking for?
Where do you realistically sit in that range?

groups.title: Start date
groups.question: How soon could you start?
ways: If you got an offer, when could you start?
What's your availability to start?
How much notice do you need to give?

groups.title: Other offers
groups.question: Do you have other offers? What's your timeline?
ways: Are you interviewing anywhere else?
Where are you in your job search?
Is anyone else close to making you an offer?

groups.title: My questions for them
groups.question: What questions do you have for us?
ways: Do you have any questions for me?
Did you have anything for us?
Before we wrap up, is there anything you'd like to ask?
